name: Maccess
summary: iPhone app that controls a Mac over Wi-Fi or from anywhere: trackpad, keyboard, screen mirroring, files and AI assistant.
description: Maccess pairs an iPhone with the free Maccess Helper on macOS to turn the phone into a trackpad, keyboard and remote control — locally over the same Wi-Fi, or from anywhere with Pro Online Access. It adds live screen mirroring, file transfer in both directions, app search and launch, Terminal and one-tap automations, plus Mackie, an AI assistant that can run tasks on the Mac. Free tier with local control; Pro $4.99/month and Max $9.99/month subscriptions.
contains: free tier: touchpad and keyboard, volume and media controls, local pairing, 1 Mac, 150K Auto AI tokens/month
Pro $4.99/month or $39.99/year: remote access, multiple Macs, mirroring, files, apps, Terminal and automations
Max $9.99/month or $79.99/year: PasteBox clipboard history, all 8 hologram scenes, 3M Auto + 500K Custom AI tokens/month
Mackie AI assistant by voice or chat; run on Maccess Cloud, Claude Code, Codex or a local model
local control works device-to-device on the same Wi-Fi without routing through the cloud
requires iOS 17+ and macOS 15.6+ via the free Maccess Helper
